web-guide-idea-33.audience: People learning an Indian language for family, work or travel.
web-guide-idea-33.offer: Provide speaking practice grounded in useful local phrases. Explain when an expression sounds formal, friendly or regional.
web-guide-idea-33.steps.0: Choose one real situation with the learner.
web-guide-idea-33.steps.1: Model phrases and let them try short exchanges.
web-guide-idea-33.steps.2: Repeat difficult sounds and finish with a mini conversation.
web-guide-idea-33.equipment: A phone and clear audio; a notebook can hold transliterations and examples.
web-guide-idea-33.returnReason: Build from greetings to longer conversations and revisit phrases the learner struggled with.
web-guide-idea-33.promotion: Record a short exchange in the language and name the variety or region you teach.

web-guide-idea-33.metadataDescription: Practise speaking, pronunciation and useful phrases in an Indian language you know well. Learn what to offer, how to start and what equipment you need.
